title: Land grid
description: Where the water is on the campaign map, as the painted map shows it: a coarse grid of samples (landmask.py's own, 25 m) classified water or land. Generated by tools/location-sync/export_land_grid.py; never hand-edited. Read by module/blank-inheritance/scripts/core/land-grid.mjs, which the Location Editor's journey checks use to tell a walk across open water from a walk along a street. design/location-editor.md section 16.

origin.description: The centre of sample (0, 0) in master-image pixels.

runs.description: Run-length encoded samples in row-major order: [value, length], value 1 for water and 0 for land. The lengths sum to cols x rows.
